scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n agent,web "npm run dev -w @video-compressor/agent" "npm run dev -w @video-compressor/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build -w @video-compressor/agent
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @video-compressor/shared && npm run generate:csp && npm run build -w @video-compressor/web
scripts.deploy:web:identity: node scripts/verify-web-env.mjs --identity && npm run build:web && node scripts/verify-release.mjs --deploy && node scripts/verify-beta-promotion.mjs && node scripts/verify-published-release.mjs && npx --yes wrangler@4.112.0 pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name wishly-app --branch main
scripts.deploy:web: node scripts/verify-web-env.mjs && npm run verify:team-production && npm run build:web && node scripts/verify-release.mjs --deploy && node scripts/verify-beta-promotion.mjs && node scripts/verify-published-release.mjs && npx --yes wrangler@4.112.0 pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name wishly-app --branch main
scripts.deploy:web:member-pilot: node scripts/verify-web-env.mjs --member-pilot && npm run verify:team-member-pilot && npm run build:web && node scripts/verify-release.mjs --deploy && node scripts/verify-beta-promotion.mjs && node scripts/verify-published-release.mjs && npx --yes wrangler@4.112.0 pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name wishly-app --branch main
scripts.release:check: npm run build && node scripts/verify-release.mjs && npm run verify:team-production
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node scripts/verify-release.mjs --package && npm run verify:team-production && node scripts/verify-beta-promotion.mjs && zsh scripts/package-mac.sh
scripts.package:dmg: node scripts/verify-release.mjs --package && npm run verify:team-production && zsh scripts/package-dmg.sh
scripts.package:dev:dmg: npm run package:dev && zsh scripts/package-dev-dmg.sh && npm run verify:dev
scripts.beta:up: npm run build -w @video-compressor/shared && npm run build -w @video-compressor/agent && node scripts/beta-up.mjs
scripts.test:team: npm run build -w @video-compressor/shared && vitest run tests/team-*.test.ts tests/team-*.test.tsx tests/drive-*.test.ts tests/catalog-*.test.ts tests/material-category.test.ts tests/transcript-ingestion.test.ts tests/preview-warm.test.ts
scripts.test:creative-library: npm run build -w @video-compressor/shared && vitest run tests/creative-library-*.test.ts tests/creative-library-*.test.tsx
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests scripts docs supabase/functions README.md TESTER_GUIDE.md RELEASE_NOTES.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests scripts docs supabase/functions README.md TESTER_GUIDE.md RELEASE_NOTES.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md package.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @video-compressor/shared && npm run typecheck:projects && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.typecheck:projects: tsc -p apps/agent/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -b apps/web && tsc -b apps/soty-review
scripts.types:supabase: npx supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public
